result.title: SWE-Critix: Post-Training Generalist Verifiers for Assessing Coding-Agent Trajectories
result.summary: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for end-to-end software engineering tasks, where a readily available oracle evaluator that defines the success criteria is often absent. This motivates verifications for coding agents that can reliably judge and explain their behavior. However, verification is non-trivial as coding agents are increasingly capable of solving long-horizon software engineering tasks. Their execution trajectories can be extremely long, containing hundreds of iterative interactions with code repositories and external tools. Existing verifiers either rely on general-purpose LLMs without specialized training or train dedicated critics that predominantly focus on producing scalar rewards, highlighting the relatively limited exploration of training-based generalist verification. We introduce SWE-Critix, a post-training pipeline for training generalist verifiers of coding-agent trajectories. Given a task and its execution trajectory, the learned verifier predicts the completion label and generates a natural-language analysis that explains its judgment. Our pipeline combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL) and trains a series of 30B models on trajectories from CodeForge-Preview. On a held-out test set, SWE-Critix improves classification accuracy from 57% for the base Qwen3-30B-A3B reasoning model to 66% after SFT and 78% after RL. We release our models, datasets, and training code to facilitate further research.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SWE-Critix，用 SFT 加 RL 的后训练流程训练 30B 通用验证器，对编码智能体的长程执行轨迹预测完成标签并生成自然语言判断分析，留出测试集上分类准确率由基座的 57% 提升到 78%。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 的视觉推理主线不直接相关，但轨迹级验证器的后训练与监督设计，可能为 latent 推理中的过程监督、贡献分配以及停止/验证决策提供可核查的方法线索。
